analysis_sets.main_report: mITT: '393 analyzed as mITT, MP in 194 and placebo in 199 individuals' (committed abstract, cache records.json PMID 32785710); 416 randomised
analysis_sets.protocol_prefers: ITT as randomised (the review's primary population: intention-to-treat)
analysis_sets.where_the_preferred_analysis_is: Supplementary Table 2 of the report (reviewer-stated; the supplement is not held, so the location is not verified by us)

32785710.basis: METCOVID's main mortality table (reviewer: 72/194 vs 76/199, mITT) and its supplement could not be held by a legitimate route: publisher PDF 403; the PMC page is abstract-only and its PDF link answers a proof-of-work bot check (recorded, not solved); Europe PMC full text 500 and no open-access supplement; the Fiocruz repository copy points its PDF at a localhost address. Neither the mITT main result nor the protocol-preferred ITT analysis is recovered.

27846344.basis: GLAGOV's clinical-event table (Table 4 of the JAMA 2016 report: first MACE, exploratory, adjudicated, safety population) is not held: publisher copy not open; Amsterdam UMC repository PDF 403; the Jagiellonian University repository copies answered a network error twice (recorded, not worked around); the ClinicalTrials.gov results post no MACE measure. Counts relayed, not held: 59/484 vs 74/484. A compatible HR is unresolved.
